correctness.rationale: Using vertices of Petersen graph as disjoint 2-subsets of five labels, its 15 edges are vertices of the degree-4 line graph. A 15-bit mask is zero-forcing exactly when iterative unique-white-neighbor closure is all ones; parallel eligible forces cannot inhibit success, so exhaustive closure is complete. Independent independently coded enumeration of all 2^15 masks found minimum size seven, exactly 2280 minimum sets, and under one-token exchange 28650 edges. All S5 relabelings give 21 orbits, 17 of size120 and four of size60. BFS weighted by those orbit sizes yields eccentricities 600 at 6 and 1680 at 7, radius6 diameter7, degree spectrum 22:180,23:480,24:240,25:240,26:660,27:240,28:60,29:180, and unordered distance counts 28650,234120,765570,1004640,483480,78540,3060 for distances1..7. Comparison to Hamming/Johnson lower bound |A\B| gives only 18540 detour pairs (3180 at h2,11640 at h3,3720 at h4) and d in {h,h+1}. Inspected pinned verify_kneser.py provides complete 32768 mask and 21-orbit exact BFS certificate; a separate alternative Petersen representation verify_classical.py is supplied. This precisely fixed finite result is supported by exhaustive combinatorial search, not extrapolation.
